text:
elena (CEO): Quick weekly — radar + safety check. Short note on where I want focus this week: stability, Private GA readiness, and cost levers. TL;DR below, details in threads and linked playbooks.

martin (VP Product): Thanks. Can you call out the top 2 product asks we should block on this week?

elena (CEO): 1) Private GA: finalize compliance checklist and legal signoff for EU customers. 2) Canary policy: strict fallback rules for model variants in case of regressions.

anya (VP Eng): On Private GA: infra has a final smoke test scheduled Thu 09:00 PT. We still need the export of audit logs from the KMS integration - @ravi any blockers?

ravi (Head SRE): KMS export looks good. One thing: the audit log pipeline spikes when exporting full key rotations; we’ll throttle by default and surface a flag in the UI. Will follow up with a short runbook.

elena (CEO): Good. Add that to the Private GA checklist and confirm docs link once done. Also, new smaller ask — tighten canary rollout windows from 24h -> 4h for model-replace in hosted tier when alerts hit error-rate threshold.

martin (VP Product): Understood. We’ll update product config and surface the change in the console release note. Will include auto-notify for teams with active routes.

anya (VP Eng): We tested the 4h canary on a synthetic workload yesterday; passing for throughput but saw p95 latency bump ~10% during KV cache warmup. Suggest we enable adaptive batching during the first 30m of rollout.

ravi (Head SRE): Agree. Add adaptive-batching + transient latency guard. Also, we exposed a brief incident yesterday (incident-4109870000) where a prometheus cardinality change triggered a scraping storm — that’s in the incident channel with a short postmortem. Main action: metric relabeling + quota for exporters.

elena (CEO): Thanks. For the org: two asks from me this week — (A) confirm Private GA checklist items done by EOD Fri; (B) triage the incident follow-ups and attach owners. If either slips, escalate to me.

martin (VP Product): Will own item A. I’ll ping legal and solutions engineering today.

anya (VP Eng): I’ll own the canary adjustments and the adaptive-batching rollout. Plan: PRs out by Wed, canary Thursday.

ravi (Head SRE): I’ll publish the runbook and metric relabel PR today. Also adding a monitoring alert for exporter cardinality increases.

deploy-bot: deploy status: 4109994300-hosted-console-0.7.9 -> success :white_check_mark:

elena (CEO): Love the clarity. Small org note — hiring update: two senior infra hires starting next month; please make time for onboarding.

martin (VP Product): :thumbsup: noted. I’ll rearrange the roadmap checkpoint to accommodate the GA push.

anya (VP Eng): A quick note on metrics: current p50/p95 generation latency (hosted API) = 22ms / 180ms. Cost-per-1k-tokens estimate for active routes trending down 6% after caching changes.

elena (CEO): Good momentum. Last thing — keep customer comms short and explicit if we change canary policies. Send me the draft comms before publish.

martin (VP Product): Draft comms by Wed EOD.

ravi (Head SRE): Runbook link (will paste once published) and I’ll add owners to the incident thread.

elena (CEO): Thanks all. Short and focused this week. If you need me, DM. :wave:
